info.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Capricornia and Central Highlands and Coalfields forecast districts
info.description:
Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce large hailstones, damaging winds and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Woorabinda, Tartrus, Blackwater, Mount Morgan, Baralaba and Marlborough.
Severe thunderstorms are no longer occurring in the Wide Bay and Burnett, Darling Downs and Granite Belt and Southeast Coast districts and the warning for these districts is CANCELLED.
106 km/h wind gust was recorded at Wellcamp Airport at 4:07 pm 4 to 5 cm hail was observed in the Warwick area late Tuesday afternoon 3 to 4 cm hail was observed around Miles around 3 pm
info.instruction: Emergency services advise people to: * Park your car undercover away from trees. * Close doors and windows. * Keep asthma medications close by. Storms and wind can trigger asthma attacks. * Charge mobile phones and power banks in case the power goes out. * Put your pets somewhere safe and make sure they can be identified in case they get lost. * Do not drive now unless you have to because conditions are dangerous. * Tell friends, family and neighbours in the area. * Go inside a strong building now. Stay inside until the storm has passed.
